source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each time an attack by one of this unit’s **POXWALKER** models destroys an enemy model other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** model, you can add 1 **destroyed** **POXWALKER** model back to this unit once this unit has finished resolving its attacks.

While **TYPHUS** leads this unit, enemy models that **TYPHUS’** Eater Plague ability destroys count, for this ability, as destroyed by an attack from one of this unit’s **POXWALKER** models.
